title: LLM-Pilot: Characterize and Optimize Performance of your LLM Inference Services
authors: Malgorzata Lazuka; Andreea Anghel; Thomas Parnell
venue_full: International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage and Analysis (SC '24)
research_focus: Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Cluster administrators must pick cost-effective GPU profiles for previously unseen LLM inference services subject to nTTFT and ITL SLOs, but a-priori performance on a given GPU is unknown and exhaustive per-LLM benchmarking is impractical because the cluster is near-saturated.
problem_statement.zh: 叢集管理者需為從未部署過的 LLM 推理服務挑選符合 nTTFT 與 ITL SLO 且具成本效益的 GPU 配置，但給定 GPU 上的事前效能未知，而叢集資源近乎飽和，無法對每個 LLM 進行詳盡 benchmark。

key_innovation.en: A two-stage system: (1) an offline performance characterization tool that benchmarks each LLM under a realistic workload generator derived from 17.3M production requests, auto-tuning maximum batch weight via binary search; (2) an online GPU recommendation tool using an XGBoost regressor with sample-weighting and monotonicity constraints over (LLM, GPU profile, user count) to recommend the cheapest deployment satisfying SLOs.
key_innovation.zh: 兩階段系統：(1) 離線性能特性化工具，以源自 17.3M 真實請求的工作負載生成器對每個 LLM 進行 benchmark，並以二分搜尋自動調校 maximum batch weight；(2) 線上 GPU 推薦工具，採用具樣本權重與單調性約束的 XGBoost 迴歸器，依 (LLM, GPU 配置, 使用者數) 推薦符合 SLO 且最具成本效益的部署。

baselines_compared: PARIS, Selecta, Morphling, PerfNet, PerfNetV2, Static policy

key_improvements.en: Delivers on performance requirements 33% more frequently than state-of-the-art (success rate 0.80 vs Static 0.65, PARIS 0.62, Selecta 0.53) while reducing recommended GPU cost by 60% on average; achieves the best S/O score across all baselines.
key_improvements.zh: 達成效能需求的頻率較既有方法高出 33%（success rate 0.80，相較 Static 0.65、PARIS 0.62、Selecta 0.53），同時平均降低 60% 的 GPU 成本；S/O score 在所有 baseline 中最高。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100 (80GB), NVIDIA A100 (40GB), NVIDIA A10 (24GB), NVIDIA T4 (16GB), NVIDIA V100 (16GB)
gpu_count: Up to 4x per profile across 14 GPU profiles
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (success rate 0.80, S/O score reported instead of MAPE)
models_validated: google/flan-t5-xl (3B), google/flan-t5-xxl (11B), google/flan-ul2 (20B), ibm/mpt-7b-instruct (7B), bigscience/mt0-xxl (13B), Salesforce/codegen2-16B, Llama-2-7B, Llama-2-13B, EleutherAI/gpt-neox-20B, bigcode/starcoder (15B)
validation_workloads: Production trace (17.3M requests over 5.5 months from IBM internal LLM platform; 2500 users; 24 LLMs)

scope_assumptions.en: Targets dense decoder/encoder-decoder LLMs served on TGIS with continuous batching; recommendations made for a fixed concurrency target (U=200, L1=100ms nTTFT, L2=50ms ITL); pods have exclusive GPU access (no co-location); benchmarking dataset of similar size takes ~8h per LLM.
scope_assumptions.zh: 目標為 TGIS 平台上以 continuous batching 服務的 dense decoder 或 encoder-decoder LLM；推薦結果基於固定的並發目標（U=200、L1=100ms nTTFT、L2=50ms ITL）；每個 pod 獨佔 GPU（無共置）；同等規模 benchmark 資料集每個 LLM 約需 8 小時。
